name: claude-result-speak
description: Reads the last sentence of Claude's response aloud via TTS. Supports macOS (say) and Windows/WSL2 (PowerShell).

message_complete.title: Message (complete)
message_complete.description: Completion notification message. Leave blank to use the language default.

message_permission.title: Message (permission)
message_permission.description: Permission prompt notification message. Leave blank to use the language default.

message_idle.title: Message (idle)
message_idle.description: Idle notification message. Leave blank to use the language default.

voice_mac.title: Voice (Mac)
voice_mac.description: macOS TTS voice name (e.g. Kyoko, Alex, Samantha)

voice_windows.title: Voice (Windows)
voice_windows.description: Windows TTS voice name (e.g. Microsoft Haruka Desktop). Leave blank for system default.

sound_complete.title: Sound (complete)
sound_complete.description: macOS notification sound. Options: Basso, Blow, Bottle, Frog, Funk, Glass, Hero, Morse, Ping, Pop, Purr, Sosumi, Submarine, Tink

sound_permission.title: Sound (permission)
sound_permission.description: macOS notification sound. Options: Basso, Blow, Bottle, Frog, Funk, Glass, Hero, Morse, Ping, Pop, Purr, Sosumi, Submarine, Tink

sound_idle.title: Sound (idle)
sound_idle.description: macOS notification sound. Options: Basso, Blow, Bottle, Frog, Funk, Glass, Hero, Morse, Ping, Pop, Purr, Sosumi, Submarine, Tink

emoji_complete.title: Emoji (complete)
emoji_complete.description: Emoji shown in the completion notification

emoji_permission.title: Emoji (permission)
emoji_permission.description: Emoji shown in the permission prompt notification

emoji_idle.title: Emoji (idle)
